purpose: Per-environment hard caps on gross notional the executor may ever run. Frozen by sha256 into every execution contract; the CLI may only LOWER a budget below these, never raise. Changing this file changes every future contract hash and is a reviewed event, not a runtime knob.
notes: live is 0.0 on purpose: no live budget exists until the 60-day paper gate passes and this file is re-issued as v2 with an explicit, reviewed number.

The code keeps an ABSOLUTE upper bound above these values that no file can exceed (contracts.ABSOLUTE_GROSS_UPPER_BOUND_USD). Two locks: the file for the reviewed number, the code for the sanity limit.

2026-08-24 revision (reviewed): testnet 500 -> 2000. The first unattended run (2026-08-17) refused the whole book because BTCUSDT's exchange minimum notional is $100 while the smallest CARRY-7d weight is 5.56% -> $27.8 at a $500 budget. Minimum viable capital for the FULL book is ~$1,800; $2,000 gives headroom. This bound also applies to any future LIVE ceiling: below ~$2,000 the strategy cannot hold BTC and becomes a different (untested) book. No COMPLETE contract existed before this change.
